title: 第7章：清障前进，意外收获
slug: 丧尸爆发我的房车能无限升级
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

枪口没有开火。

挡风玻璃前方两百米，那根枪管在落日余晖里晃了两下，然后垂了下去。

屋顶上的人蹲了下去，双手抱着脑袋，枪也丢在脚边。

系统探测的蓝色标记没变色，活人，是一个吓坏了的活人。

赵铁柱已经摸到侧门把手上，防暴叉横在膝盖前。

林昊把车缓缓开了过去，停在民房院墙外。

“上面的，枪放下！踢到屋檐边上！”

男人照做了，一支双管猎枪沿着瓦片滚到屋檐边缘。

他五十来岁，胡茬满脸，眼窝凹进去一截，嘴唇干裂成翻卷的白皮。

他屋顶上蹲了两天，没有吃也没有喝。

一只丧尸咬了他老伴，他用猎枪把那只丧尸的头轰成了烂瓜。

老伴没了，他把她埋在了院子里。

然后他爬上屋顶，枪架在膝盖上对着路口，来什么打什么。

苏晴递了瓶水上去，老马灌了半瓶，呛得整个人弓起来咳。

林昊没打算带他。

车厢七个人，底盘已经摇摇欲坠，再多一个，悬挂直接散架，那就没得玩了。

“你们走吧，我不走，老伴在院子里，我要留下来陪她”

”前面的省道往西三公里有岔路，能拐上高速。”

“但高速堵死了——几十辆车摞在一起，我在屋顶看得一清二楚。”

是堵的。

大家告别了老人，全部人上了车。

车重新轧上省道，三公里后岔路上高速匝道。

老马说得分毫不差。

前方一公里处，路面变成了钢铁坟场。

几十辆车挤成一坨，追尾的、骑上隔离带的、斜插在护栏里的，层层叠叠。一辆集装箱卡车横亘正中，后面的车像多米诺骨牌一样锁成铁板一块。

两侧车道连应急车道全堵死了。

林昊停车，点开物资探测。

地图加载了两秒，红点铺开……

【堵塞路段扫描完成】

【移动目标约40个·标记为普通丧尸·无变异体信号】

【多辆车内检测到可用物资】

【注意：特殊物资信号（橙色标记），来源——厢式货车，位于路段中段右侧】

四十只，散在车阵各处，没有抱团，也没有变异体。

那辆橙色标记的货车在中段，得穿过至少三百米的车缝才到。

赵铁柱从副驾驶位上抬头，看了前方的路况半分钟。

“下去打，如果靠碾的话，车身撑不到仓库。”

林昊点头。

“方案—，你我下去步战。

苏晴车顶盯哨，有情况按喇叭。

陈明开车跟进，我们清到哪儿，车跟到哪儿。

不超过十码。”

赵铁柱没废话，拉开门跳了下去。

防暴叉右手，窗帘杆矛左手。

林昊猎弩上弦装箭，弩箭壶绑在腰侧，手枪别在后腰。

“陈明。开过车没有？”

“自动挡……开过几次。”

“这车也是。D挡前进，R挡倒车。油门轻踩，跟着我们走。”

陈明两手抖着爬进驾驶座，后面李小雨拽了一下他的衣角。

没说话，但手指扣得紧。

苏晴抱着妞妞上了车顶，妞妞趴在她肩头，大拇指含在嘴里，大眼睛往前愣愣地看。

两个人，四十只丧尸，三百米车阵。

赵铁柱在前，林昊侧后三步。

第一只丧尸蹲在一辆面包车后座里，车门敞着，听到脚步扭过头。

赵铁柱一步上去，防暴叉的U形卡口精准卡进脖子，往前一送，钉在座椅靠背上，拧了半圈，丧尸颈椎发出碎裂的闷响，歪了下去。

陈明在驾驶座上全程盯着，方向盘被他掐出两道深印。

刚才他用了整整半分钟才杀死一只被绊住的丧尸。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The gun did not fire.

Two hundred meters in front of the windshield, the gun barrel swayed twice in the afterglow of the setting sun, and then hung down.

The man on the roof squatted down, holding his head in his hands, and dropped his gun at his feet.

The blue mark detected by the system did not change color. It was a living person, a frightened living person.

Zhao Tiezhu had already touched the side door handle, with the anti-riot fork across his knees.

Lin Hao drove the car slowly and stopped outside the courtyard wall of a private house.

"Above, put down the gun! Kick it to the edge of the roof!"

The man did so, and a double-barreled shotgun rolled along the tiles to the edge of the eaves.

He was in his fifties, with stubble all over his face, sunken eye sockets, and chapped lips that turned into curled white skin.

He squatted on the roof for two days without eating or drinking.

A zombie bit his wife, and he blasted the zombie's head into a pulp with a shotgun.

His wife was gone and he buried her in the yard.

Then he climbed onto the roof, held the gun on his knees and pointed it at the intersection, shooting whatever came.

Su Qing handed her a bottle of water, and Lao Ma drank half of the bottle, choking and making her whole body arch up and cough.

Lin Hao had no intention of taking him.

There are seven people in the car, and the chassis is already shaky. If there is one more person, the suspension will fall apart, and there will be no fun.

"You go, I won't leave, my wife is in the yard, I want to stay with her"

"There is a branch road three kilometers west of the provincial road in front, and you can turn onto the expressway."

"But the highway was blocked - dozens of cars were piled on top of each other, and I could see clearly from the rooftop."

It's blocked.

We said goodbye to the old man and got in the car.

The car rolled onto the provincial highway again, and after three kilometers, it branched off onto a high-speed ramp.

Lao Ma said the score was exactly the same.

One kilometer ahead, the road turned into a steel cemetery.

Dozens of cars were packed into a pile, rear-ended, riding on the isolation belt, and stuck diagonally in the guardrail, all on top of one another.A container truck stood in the middle, with the cars behind it locked together like dominoes.

The lanes on both sides and even the emergency lane were blocked.

Lin Hao stopped the car and clicked on the material detection.

The map loaded for two seconds, and the red dots spread out...

[Scanning of blocked road sections completed]

[About 40 moving targets·Marked as ordinary zombies·No mutant signal]

[Available supplies detected in multiple vehicles]

[Note: Special supplies signal (orange mark), source - van, located on the right side of the middle section of the road]

Forty of them, scattered throughout the car formation, no grouping, no mutants.

The orange-marked truck was in the middle and had to pass through a gap of at least three hundred meters to reach it.

Zhao Tiezhu raised his head from the passenger seat and looked at the road ahead for half a minute.

"Go down and fight. If you rely on crushing it, the car body won't be able to support the warehouse."

Lin Hao nodded.

"Plan - you and I will fight on foot.

Su Qing watches the whistle on the roof of the car and honks the horn when necessary.

Chen Ming drove to follow us, and the car followed us wherever we cleared.

No more than ten yards."

Zhao Tiezhu didn't talk nonsense, opened the door and jumped out.

The riot fork is in the right hand and the curtain rod spear is in the left hand.

Lin Hao's hunting crossbow was loaded with arrows, the crossbow kettle was tied to his waist, and the pistol was pinned to his back.

"Chen Ming. Have you ever driven a car?"

"Automatic... I've driven it a few times."

"This car is the same. D gear goes forward and R gear reverses. Press the accelerator lightly and follow us."

Chen Ming climbed into the driver's seat with trembling hands, and Li Xiaoyu tugged on the corner of his clothes from behind.

No words were spoken, but the fingers were clasped tightly.

Su Qing hugged Niu Niu and got on the roof of the car. Niu Niu lay on her shoulder, with her thumb in her mouth and her big eyes looking forward blankly.

Two people, forty zombies, a three-hundred-meter car formation.

Zhao Tiezhu was in front, and Lin Hao was three steps back.

The first zombie was squatting in the back seat of a van, with the door open, and turned its head when it heard footsteps.

Zhao Tiezhu stepped forward, and the U-shaped bayonet of the anti-riot fork was accurately inserted into his neck. He moved it forward and nailed it to the back of the seat. After twisting half a turn, the zombie's cervical vertebrae made a muffled sound of shattering and tilted.

Chen Ming stared at the driver's seat the whole time, and he made two deep marks on the steering wheel.

Just now it took him half a minute to kill a trapped zombie.
